These responses manifest as galvanic skin conductance changes that correlate with the temporal structure of repeated stimuli. The temporal interval anticipation primitive extracts predictive markers from these responses—specifically, anticipatory peaks at X, Y, and Z—which indicate cognitive processing of temporal regularities. The behavioral cycle initiation primitive extends this into a dynamic system where each stimulus initiates a prolonged internal state trajectory. Together, these primitives define a closed-loop system of perception-action-introspection, enabling both GSI’s probabilistic inference over time-series and GSE’s simulation of internal behavioral states. Failure modes arise when temporal consistency breaks down or when physiological thresholds are not met, disrupting the integrity of the modeled cycles.
